boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cash, Check, Visa, Mastercard, Discover & AMEX
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Available at the Box Office. Opens 1 hour before event. PLEASE BRING A PICTURE ID, THE ACTUAL CREDIT CARD USED TO PURCHASE THE TICKETS, AND YOUR ORDER NUMBER.

venues.parkingDetail: Located in the lot on Monroe Street across from the center, South Hall Garage, and Clinton Avenue. There is a $5.00 charge
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: This venue is accessible. Elevator available for patrons with special needs.

generalInfo.generalRule: NO Smoking NO Flash Photography NO Recording Devices of any kind NO Food/Drink allowed in Concert Hall
generalInfo.childRule: Varies depending on event. See individual events for age restrictions.
